description: v0.8 Galapagos happy-path: user asks for a daylight-maximising Galapagos run with two sliders. The assistant first calls gh_plugin_check to confirm Galapagos is installed, then calls gh_galapagos_setup with both genomes and a daylight fitness clause, then ends the turn with a summary. Exercises the v0.8 gh_galapagos_setup tool shape against a clean two-tool, three-provider-call flow.
userPrompt: Set up a Galapagos run to maximize daylight on my facade with two sliders: panel_depth 100-400mm and stagger 0-500mm.

interactions.text: Before I wire up the solver, let me confirm Galapagos is installed.
Galapagos is present. Configuring the two genomes and the daylight fitness objective.
Galapagos setup is validated: two genomes (panel_depth, stagger) wired to a daylight-maximising fitness clause. Open the Galapagos Editor in Rhino and press Start to begin the search.
